blocks.html:
Response returned when authentication succeeds but must be completed with
a multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge before issuing a token.

types.name: AuthMfaRequiredResponse
types.description:
Response returned when authentication succeeds but must be completed with
a multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge before issuing a token.

children.name: token
children.description: A token without an actor type (permissions) attached to it. Used to request and confirm verifications.

children.name: mfa_required
children.description: Indicates that the client must complete the returned MFA challenge.

children.name: auth_identity_id
children.description: The ID of the authentication identity being challenged.

children.name: auth_provider
children.description: The authentication provider handling the challenge.

children.name: methods
children.description: Available methods for completing this challenge.
